pagerbot: [PAGER] 06:10UTC - Suspicious outbound logship detected from embeddings-service -> thirdparty-obs.example.com. 1xx tokens with short-lived auth headers observed. link: https://internal/alerts/6832100000
oncall-sre: Ack. I'm on it. Spawning triage channel and grabbing traces.
oncall-sre: quick check: is this the new metrics shipper we rolled yesterday?
maria: yes, we rolled the metrics-forwarder v2 to staging then prod at 02:00UTC (helm chart #ff12). It includes optional outbound sink config.
kevin: confirming config: looks like sink list mistakenly contained the analytics endpoint for external partner. It's not supposed to be enabled in prod.
sec-rotations: @oncall-sre @kevin please treat as potential data egress. Start containment: block egress to thirdparty-obs.example.com from embeddings-service subnets and disable shipper.
oncall-sre: executing now: `kubectl -n model-prod set env deployment/metrics-forwarder EXTERNAL_SINK=disabled --record`
oncall-sre: also applied fw rule to drop traffic to 3rdparty-obs (ip 54.210.33.9) at edge loadbalancer.
kevin: rolling back helm values to previous release 1.2.3: `helm upgrade metrics-forwarder ./charts/metrics-forwarder --set externalSink.enabled=false --reuse-values`
sec-rotations: good. Next: assess what leaked. Any tokens in logs or headers?
maria: initial grep of logshipper buffer shows Authorization: Bearer st-*** short-lived tokens (120s). They are opaque session tokens issued by embeddings-auth when users request ephemeral streams.
sec-rotations: do we know which scopes those tokens had?
maria: scopes: embed.read and stream.temp. No user PII in payloads themselves, but request traces include customer IDs (hashed) and request metadata (prompt hashes).
cust-svcs: we need a customer impact assessment. Which customers had requests hitting embeddings-service between 02:00-06:05UTC?
kevin: running query now: `select distinct customer_id from requests where service='embeddings' and ts between '2026-03-15T02:00:00Z' and '2026-03-15T06:05:00Z'`
kevin: preliminary: 4 enterprise customers (cust-A, cust-B, cust-C, cust-D). Volume: ~2.1k requests, ~8k tokens.
sec-rotations: rotate any long-lived keys that might be able to mint these session tokens. Which issuers can mint?
maria: session tokens are minted by embeddings-auth using service account svc-embed-issuer, which uses KMS key projects/redwood/keys/emb-iss. That key is fine; tokens are short-lived and require that SA private creds which are not exposed. However the logshipper included the tokens (clearly a bug in sanitization).
sec-rotations: mitigate by revoking current ephemeral tokens and forcing reissue. We can't revoke tokens already issued except by rotating the signing key. Plan: rotate the KMS signing key for session tokens, trigger auth service restart to pick up new key, and invalidate existing tokens.
oncall-sre: on it. Creating JIRA INC-68321 and assigning to sec-rotations for key rotation.
sec-rotations: ETA for rotation and deploy ~30m. We'll coordinate a hot restart with minimal customer impact (rolling restarts across zones).
legal: Please capture what exact customer IDs and request hashes were in the leak. We're preparing notification templates.
cust-svcs: I'll draft initial outreach for affected customers, recommend holding message: brief, we detected potential exposure of ephemeral session tokens to a third-party analytics endpoint; tokens were short-lived and scope-limited; we're rotating signing keys and will follow up with details.
kevin: containment done, rollback confirmed, ingress to thirdparty stopped. Collecting artifacts: pcap, shipper buffer, and full request list.
sec-rotations: after rotation, run an audit to ensure no other service uses externalSink flag in prod. Add helm guard in CI.
oncall-sre: adding checklist to thread:
- block egress to 54.210.33.9 (done)
- disable external sink in metrics-forwarder (done)
- helm rollback to 1.2.3 (done)
- rotate KMS signing key emb-iss (in progress)
- force tokens invalidation via auth restart (planned)
- notify affected customers (pending)
- legal and security review for disclosure (pending)
sec-rotations: I'll paste the rotation command and steps once ready.
sec-rotations: rotation step 1: create new key version in KMS: `gcloud kms keys versions create --key=emb-iss --location=global --keyring=redwood-kr`
sec-rotations: step 2: update auth service env to point to new key version and restart pods.
sec-rotations: step 3: monitor auth token issuance errors and set up a temporary allowlist for control-plane calls.
maria: auth pods will restart gracefully. We expect <1min token issuance blip per pod.
kevin: I'm snapshotting the shipper buffer and pushing to secure S3 bucket `s3://sec-scrub/6832100000/` for forensics.
legal: preparing privacy-notice draft; will join after sec summary.
oncall-sre: assigning oncall to follow through incident postmortem: @maria lead, @kevin infra, @sec-rotations security.
pagerbot: Incident INC-68321 created, severity set P1. Pager escalations adjusted.
sec-rotations: update: created new KMS key version and updated auth config. Rolling restart started.
maria: restart complete across all regions. Auth service reports new key version 3. Token issuance now tied to new key.
sec-rotations: monitoring for failed tokens and session renewals. So far 0.2% renew errors, auto-retries succeeding.
cust-svcs: draft notice ready. Will wait for final confirmation of rotated keys and list of customers.
legal: we may need to notify regulators depending on customer region. Please include whether any EU customers had plain identifiers.
kevin: EU customer (cust-C) present but identifiers were hashed; no clear PII.
sec-rotations: final assessment: tokens were short-lived and scope-limited, leak limited to analytics partner endpoint, egress stopped, keys rotated. Recommend controlled customer notification and internal postmortem.
oncall-sre: closing immediate bridge. Will create postmortem document and add remediation: CI helm schema to block external sink in prod, shipper sanitization fix, automated egress policy tests.
maria: thanks all.
later-messages: (after 4h) sec-rotations: postmortem draft uploaded https://internal/pm/INC-68321-pm. Action items assigned.
legal: approve customer notice. Cust-svcs please send via secure channel and CC security.
cust-svcs: notice dispatched to cust-A,B,C,D. No inbound escalations yet.
kevin: closing logs in s3 after redaction.
pagerbot: Incident INC-68321 status -> resolved (2026-03-15T11:05:00Z).
